name: Pure Protein Chocolate Deluxe Bar (WARNING)
whyItWorks: Heavily sweetened with maltitol syrup—a potent sugar alcohol (polyol) known for inducing osmotic diarrhea, violent intestinal rumbling, and painful cramps even in healthy individuals.
prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID if prone to diarrhea or during active flares. Check ingredients list for maltitol, sorbitol, or xylitol.
